items.text: Yesu yaleerwa imbeli waPilato
Kho olwa bwashia mutsuli abakhulundu babakuhani bosi nende abakofu babandu basanjilana khuYesu, okhumwira;
nibamu-boha, nibamuyila, nibamuhaana mumakhono kaPilato, owali nali Kafuna.
Okhufwa khwaYuda
Mana Yuda, owali namukhobile, olwa yalola shinga eshiina olwa shiali nishimufwiliile, niyeekalukhasia, nakalusia tsifeetsa etsio amakhumi kataru ewabakhulundu babakuhani nende abakofu,
naboola mbu Enzonoonile, olwa ekhobile amabanga koubula eshikha. Nebutswa bakalusia bari Elo nelikhuwa shiina khwifwe? Tsia olikasia omwene.
Naye nasukuna hasi tsifeetsa etsio muhekalu, natsia; narulayo, niyeemika.
Mana abakhulundu babakuhani nibabukula tsifeetsa etsio nibaboola mbu Nomusilo okhutsira mwibiishilo liebihaanwa, shichila nobukusi bwamatsayi.
Kho nibasanga halala, nibatsikula omukunda kwomulonji, mbu kube okwokhuyabilungwamwo abacheni.
Niko akachila omukunda okwo nikulangwa mbu Omukunda Kwamatsayi okhuula olwa leelo.
Kho nikoosibwa akaboolwa nende omunabii Yeremia, mbu Nibabukula tsifeetsa etsio amakhumi kataru, obukusi bwoyo owachelelwa obukusi, owa abandi abomubaana baIsiraeli bachelela obukusi;
nibatsiikhoonyela okhukula omukunda kwomulonji, shinga Omwami olwa yandaka.
Pilato yareeba Yesu amareebo
Kho Yesu yasinjila imbeli waKafuna; naye Kafuna namureeba mbu Niwe Omuruchi wabaYahudi? Naye Yesu namusunjila, mbu Nolwa oboola iwe.
Ne olwa abakhulundu babakuhani nende abakofu bamuchonjela shiyakalusia likhuwa ta.
Mana Pilato namureeba ari Shiohulilanga amakhuwa shinga olwa kali amanji aka barumbulanga khwiwe?
Naye naramukalusia kata likhuwa elala ta, okhuula olwa Kafuna yahuka muno.
Yesu yakhalachilwa eshiina shiokhufwa
Ne khwisabo elo Kafuna yayinyanga okhulekhuulila abomukanda omubohe mulala, owa beenya.
Ne bali nibali nende omubohe undi owamanyikhana, owalangwa mbu Baraba.
Kho olwa bali nibakhung'aaniile halala, Pilato nabareeba ari Niwina owa mwenya mbu emulekhuulile? Baraba, nohomba Yesu oulangwa mbu Kristo?
Okhuba yali naluutsi mbu imbalikha niyo eyichilile nibamuhaana mumakhonoke.

Nolwa yali nashiikhaale khushifumbi shiobuyaasii, omukhasiwe yamukhupila omunwa, ari Oramukholakhwo omundu omulunjishi oyo likhuwa liosi ta; shichila inyanga yino enyasiibwe amakhuwa amanji mwilooro khululwe.
Ne abakhulundu babakuhani nende abakofu batswanzwania abandu mbu bamusabe Baraba, nibamwira Yesu.
Naye Kafuna nakalusia, nabasunjila mbu Khubano babili, niwina owa mwenya mbu emulekhuulile? Nibaboola bari Baraba.
Pilato nabareeba ari Kho nemukhole endie Yesu oulangwa mbu Kristo? Bosi nibaboola bari Abambwe khumusalaba.
Nabareeba ari Ne nibii shiina elia akholile? Nibameeta butswa okhuyiiba, bari Abambwe khumasulaba.

Kho olwa Pilato yalola shinga olwa aranyala eshindu ta, habula mbu indiri yali niyenya okhwikhola, yabukula amatsi, nasaaba amakhono imbeli wabomukanda, naboola ari Shindikhwo nende eshiina shiamabanga komundu uno omulunjishi ta; tsie mulikasie abeene.
Abandu bosi nibakalusia, nibasunga mbu Amabangake kabe khwifwe, khandi khubaana beefwe.
Mana yabalekhuulila Baraba; ne yamunywekha Yesu, namuhaana mbu abambwe khumusalaba.
Abasikari banyokhoosia Yesu
Mana abasikari baKafuna nibamuyila Yesu muPraitorio; nibamukhung'aanila ing'anda yabwe yosi;
nibamufwalula tsingubotsie, nibamufwala eshiifwalo eshiranzayi.
Nibalukha olusimbi lwamahwa, nibalura khumurwekwe, nende olusi mumukhonokwe musaatsa; nibasikama hasi imbeliwe, nibamunyokhoosia, bari Mulembe, Omuruchi wabaYahudi!
Nibamunyilikhakhwo amare, nibabukula olusi olwo nibamunywekha khumurwe.
Nolwa bali nibamilile okhumunyokhoosia, bamufwalula eshiifwalo eshio, nibamufwala ebiifwalo bibie omwene, nibamurusia nibamuyila okhumubamba khumusalaba.
Yesu yabambwa khumusalaba
Ne olwa bali nibashirula banyoola omundu weKirene, oulangwa mbu Simoni; nibamuluunyia okhutsia ninabo, achinje omusalabakwe.
Ne olwa bali niboolile ahalangwa mbu Gologotsa, eshisina mbu Habundu wEshihanganga,
bamunyweesia idivai eyatsokasibwa induswe; ne olwa ynli nakoonyeeleelekhwo, yaloba okhunywa.
Ne olwa bali nibamubambile khumusalaba, nibakabana ebiifwalobie, nibabiupila ikha;
nibeekhalayo nibamuhenga.
Nibaraho hekulu hamurwekwe obwinjililwibwe, nibuhandiikwa mbu UNO NIYE YESU, OMURUCHI WAEAYAHUDI.
Khandi abunuuli babili babambwa ninaye halala, mulala khumukhonokwe musaatsa, noundi khumukhono mukhasi.
Abali nibabirangaho nabo nibamunyeka, nibamuyuyila emirwe,
nibasunga bari Iwe oulikulula ihekalu nochiumbakha khandi mundaalo tsitaru, wihonie omwene; noba noli Omwana waNyasaye, wishe orule khumusalaba.
Khandi abakhulundu babakuhani nabo bario nibamunyokhoosia halala nende abahandiichi nende abakofu, nibasunga bari
Yahonia abandi, ne shianyala okhwihonia omwene ta. Niye Omuruchi waIsiraeli; kho yeeshe bulaano khumusalaba, mana khulamusuubilila.
Yeesiikanga Nyasaye; amuhonie bulaano, naba namwenyanga; okhuba yasunga ari Nisie Omwana waNyasaye.
Nabo abanuuli aba yabambwa ninabo halala nibamunyeka bario.
Okhufwa khwaYesu
Ne okhurula khusaa yakhasasaba eshialo shiosi shieekhola eshiilima okhuula khusaa yashienda.
Mana shinga khusaa yashienda Yesu yayiiba nende omwoyo omukhongo, ari Eli, Eli, lema sabakutsani? Mbu Nyasaye wanje, Nyasaye wanje, undeshile mbushiina?
Abandi khubali nibasinjiileho, olwa bahulila, baboola mbu Omundu uno alanganga Eliya.
Habwenaho oundi khubo natsia tsimbilo, nabukula eshiangwe, nashiitsusia idivai eyiraanyile nara khulusi, namunyweesia.
Abandi nibaboola mbu Lekha, khulole Eliya naba niyeetsa okhumuhonia.
Yesu nayiiba khandi nomwoyo omukhongo, nalekhuula omwoyokwe.
Ne lola, ingubo ishinga eyomuhekalu niyirandukha ebitonye bibili, okhurula ikulu okhuula hasi; eshialo nashio nishirenga; tsinyanda nitsiatikha;
ebilindwa nibiikukha; khandi emibili eminji chiabatakatifu abali nibakona nachio chialamusibwa;
nibarula mubilindwa inyuma wokhulamukhakhwe, nibeenjila mwitookho elo litakatifu, nibaloleshela abandu abanji.
Naye omuseesia nende aba yali ninabo nibamuhenganga Yesu, olwa balola okhurenga khweshialo nende amakhuwa akakholekha, baria muno, nibaboola mbu Toto mwene, uno abeele Omwana waNyasaye.
Khandi abakhasi abanji bali nibaliyo, abali nibasinjiile ehale nibahenganga; abali nibalondaanenje nende Yesu okhurula eGalilaya, nibamukhalabanila;
ne mubo balimwo Mariamu Magadalene, nende Mariamu nyinabwe Yakobo nende Yusufu, nende nyinabwe abaana baZebadayo.
Yesu yaalisibwa mung'ani
Ne olwa bwoola mungoloobe, omusaatsa omuyinda owarula eArimatsaya, oweliiralie mbu Yusufu, niyeetsa; naye yali omwechi waYesu;
omundu uno natsia ewaPilato namusaba omulambo kwaYesu. Mana Pilato nalaka mbu akuheebwe.
Mana Yusufu nakubukula omulambo, nakufwimba mungubo indafu yeikitani,
nakwalisia mung'aniyiye imbia, eya yali niyayaba mulwanda; mana naselenjesia lichina likali nalira mumuliango kweing'ani, niyeenyokha.
Naye Mariamu Magadalene yali naliho, nende Mariamu undi oyo, nibeekhaale ahahengana nende eshilindwa.
Abalindi balinda hashilindwa
Kho mukamba, niyo inyanga eyalonda khuYokhwikhwanilia, abakhulundu babakuhani halala nende abaFarisayo bali nibakhung'aanile ewa Pilato,
nibaboola bari Omwami, khwitsuliile mbu omukaatii tsana yaboola, olwa yali nashiliho mwoyo, ari Olunyuma lwetsindaalo tsitaru ndakhalamushe.

Kho olachilisie mbu eshilindwa shilindwe butinyu okhuula khunyanga yakhataru; abeechibe baleshe okhwitsa nibamwiba, nibaboolela abandu bari Alamuushe narula mubafu; mana obushiamu bwolunyuma bwakhashila obwambeli.
Pilato nabasunjila ari Abalindi muli ninabo; tsie, mushilinde butinyu shinga olwa munyala.
Kho mana batsia, nibalinda eshilindwa butinyu, nibabalikha lichina elo eshibalikho, abalindi nibaliho ninabo.
